ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a rectangle MNQR, with N at the upper left, Q at the upper right, M at the lower left, and R at the lower right. The two diagonals NR and MQ of the rectangle are drawn and intersect at interior point P. Reasoning: The diagonals of a rectangle bisect each other, so P is the midpoint of diagonal NR, therefore NP = NR/2. Given NR = 2x + 10 and NP = 2x - 30, set up the equation: 2x - 30 = (2x + 10)/2. Multiplying both sides by 2 gives 4x - 60 = 2x + 10, so 2x = 70, x = 35. Thus NP = 2x - 30 = 70 - 30 = 40. The diagonals of a rectangle are equal and bisect each other, so half-diagonal MP is equal to NP, therefore MP = 40.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify MNQR as a rectangle with diagonals NR and MQ drawn, intersecting at P. Read from the text that NR = 2x + 10 and NP = 2x - 30, and the target is MP. Use the rectangle property that diagonals bisect each other, so P is the midpoint of NR and therefore NP = NR/2. Set 2x - 30 = (2x + 10)/2, solve for x, then compute NP. Finally use the rectangle property that diagonals are congruent and bisect each other, so the half-diagonals NP and MP are equal; hence MP = NP.

method.method_draft: From the image, view P as the crossing point of the two diagonals inside rectangle MNQR. Read from the text that the full diagonal NR has length 2x + 10 while the segment from N to the diagonal intersection P has length 2x - 30. Use the fact that the intersection of a rectangle's diagonals is the rectangle's center, so it is equidistant from all four vertices. Thus PN is a radius from the center to a vertex, and NR is a full diagonal passing through the center, so NR = 2PN. Solve 2x + 10 = 2(2x - 30), giving PN, and then conclude MP = PN because M and N are both vertices equidistant from the center P.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个矩形 MNQR，顶点 N 在左上，Q 在右上，M 在左下，R 在右下。两条对角线 NR 和 MQ 在矩形内部相交于点 P。

推理：矩形的对角线互相平分，所以 P 是对角线 NR 的中点。因此 NR = 2 · NP。题目给出 NR = 2x + 10，NP = 2x - 30，所以建立方程：2x + 10 = 2(2x - 30)。解得 2x + 10 = 4x - 60，70 = 2x，x = 35。于是 NP = 2x - 30 = 70 - 30 = 40。因为矩形对角线相交点到各顶点距离相等，所以 MP = NP = 40。
